LESSON: USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation 2.3 Responsibility over Plants (6 lessons) By the end of the sub- stran
Topic 2.4: Use of Natural Resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Use of Natural Resources. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you conserve the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources
2. discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Use of Natural Resources helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES
Study Use of Natural Resources like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources

What this means
In this part you learn to explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Use of Natural Resources” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Use of Natural Resources in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Use of Natural Resources is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Use of Natural Resources” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Use of Natural Resources in your own words. (skill: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Use of Natural Resources to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources.
3. Practise this skill: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Use of Natural Resources from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Use of Natural Resources: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Use of Natural Resources?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you conserve the environment?
2. How do human beings benefit from natural resources?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Use of Natural Resources means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources.
5. Be able to: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
